content.title: How to Watch Heat vs. Hornets for Free: NBA Streaming, Tipoff Time, Betting Odds
content.text: The Miami Heat face off against the Charlotte Hornets during Tuesday’s slate of NBA games.Mar 17, 2026 6:00 PM EDTMiami Heat guard Tyler Herro (14), guard Davion Mitchell (45), forward Andrew Wiggins (22) and center Bam Adebayo (13) high five after a play against the Oklahoma City Thunder. Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images In This Story Bam Adebayo and the Miami Heat will hit the road on Tuesday for a matchup against Kon Knueppel and the Charlotte Hornets. The Heat come into the game with a 38-30 record, good for seventh place in the Eastern Conference, most recently falling to Paolo Banchero and the Orlando Magic 121-117 on Saturday. Miami is led by All-Star Norman Powell, who leads the team with 22.5 points per game, while guard Tyler Herro is close behind at 21.5 points The Hornets, on the other hand, go into the matchup with a 34-34 record and are in playoff position, currently with the No. 10 seed. Charlotte most recently fell to Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs 115-102 on Saturday. Brandon Miller is leading the team in scoring with 20.4 points per game, but Knueppel has arguably been the Hornets’ most impressive player, breaking the rookie 3-point record. Miami Heat center Bam Adebayo (13) is congratulated by guard Tyler Herro (14)Bob DeChiara-Imagn Images Heat vs. Hornets Tipoff Time Heat vs. Hornets will tip off on Tuesday at 7:00 p.m. ET. The game will be played at the Spectrum Center in Charlotte, North Carolina. What TV Channel is Heat vs. Hornets on? The matchup between the Heat vs. Hornets will air on FanDuel Sports Network Southeast and FanDuel Sports Network Sun.
